title: Outriders
html:
Dune Raider outriders camp across the road from the Ancient Battlefield. Sergeant Bennet Vale wants to know who pays them.

About

Given bySergeant Bennet Vale
Level18
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Talins Pay Chit ×1
  • Raider War Token ×3

Steps

  1. Talk to Sergeant Bennet Vale to get the quest.
  2. Kill 15 Dune Outriders at their camp across the road from the Ancient Battlefield (). They also drop Raider War Tokens: keep 3.
  3. Kill Dust-Rider Talin and take Talin’s Pay Chit from him.
  4. Show Fred Skentz the pay chit and the 3 Raider War Tokens.
  5. Report to the Bloomguard Quartermaster at the post by Fred’s gate to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold1,280
Character XP40,000
Quest points1

What Sergeant Bennet Vale says

Fred Skentz: Black wax. Raiders don't seal anything. They can't be bothered.

Fred Skentz: The stamp on this chit and on the tokens is a Thak paymaster's mark. I've had their coin across my counter. It's heavy and badly struck, and nobody out here mints it but the Thak.

Fred Skentz: So the outriders ride on Thak pay. I'll keep these. Go and tell the Bloomguard quartermaster at the post by my gate before somebody offers to buy the news off you.

You: Fred Skentz says the outriders are on Thak pay. Talin's chit carries a Thak paymaster's stamp.

Bloomguard Quartermaster: Then Sergeant Vale was right, and I owe him a drink.

Bloomguard Quartermaster: If the Thak are paying raiders this far west, they want the road watched before their scouts come down it. Agauton needs to hear that. I'll send a rider east tonight.

Bloomguard Quartermaster: Here's your pay from the post's box. Sergeant Vale said you'd earn it.

Handing it in

"Here's your pay from the post's box. Sergeant Vale said you'd earn it."
